headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment Certification on Listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified timely payment of interest on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (SRND) listed on stock exchanges, fulfilling disclosure obligations under SEBI LODR Regulation 57.
detail: Under SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations 2015, Reg. 57 mandates issuers of publicly-listed debt securities to certify timely interest payments to the exchange. Sammaan Capital's notification on NSE confirms it has discharged interest obligations on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued via public issue. This is a mandatory periodic disclosure, not a transaction, reflecting ongoing compliance with debt servicing commitments.
